decks.notes: This deck relies on control elements and mono black cards to maintain dominance over the opponent. It uses cards like Thoughtseize and Night's Whisper to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also utilizing Field of Ruin and Karn, the Great Creator to control the opponent's board state. The deck also focuses on resource generation through cards like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Cabal Coffers. It further enhances control with cards like Demolition Field and Sheoldred's Edict. Finally, it has powerful finishers in the form of Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and The One Ring.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize an aggressive strategy with a focus on early game disruption and direct damage. The deck aims to control the board with counterspells and removal spells, while also applying pressure with evasive creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also utilizes cantrips and card selection spells like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to maintain card advantage and consistency. By combining disruption, burn, and efficient threats, the deck aims to quickly overpower and defeat the opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of powerful planeswalkers (Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six) and versatile removal cards (Prismatic Ending, Solitude, and Fury). The deck also aims to generate value and card advantage through the powerful landfall abilities of Omnath, Locus of Creation. The inclusion of Leyline Binding helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while the presence of Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Nissa, Resurgent Animist provide additional threats and power. The deck also utilizes a small but efficient mana base to support its strategy.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan with Counterspells and removal spells like Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to control the board with efficient spells and tempo plays, utilizing card filtering with Preordain and Expressive Iteration to find the right answers. Murktide Regent provides a powerful finisher when the game goes longer, while cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation help protect your creatures and spells from removal or disruption.

This deck aims to control the board using removal spells and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. It also utilizes powerful multicolor cards, such as Omnath, Locus of Creation and Prismatic Ending, to generate value and outvalue opponents in the mid-to-late game. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure mana fixing and consistency, as well as key enchantments like Leyline Binding to disrupt opponent strategies. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining control of the game while steadily advancing its own board state to secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Amulet of Vigor, while also utilizing land bounce effects from cards like Golgari Rot Farm and Simic Growth Chamber. The goal is to search for and play Primeval Titan to fetch powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens, which can then be used to generate a strong board presence and overwhelming damage output. This combo-oriented strategy allows the deck to quickly assemble a powerful board state and win the game in a short amount of time.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through disruption and removal spells like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent with powerful threats such as Karn, the Great Creator and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It also includes synergies with Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Cabal Coffers to generate mana advantage. The One Ring serves as a win condition in the late game, while Cling to Dust provides additional card advantage and graveyard hate. Field of Ruin and Demolition Field help to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. With a low mana curve and a mix of direct damage and creature threats, this deck aims to win the game as fast as possible before the opponent can stabilize. By applying constant pressure and preventing the opponent from gaining life or stabilizing the board, this deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they can mount a defense.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying fast, efficient threats. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's hand, while employing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats. The synergy between disruption, aggression, and removal allows the deck to control the game and secure victories through overwhelming pressure.

This deck focuses on using powerful control spells and creatures to dominate the game. It utilizes a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The main win condition revolves around powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude to pressure the opponent and close out the game. The deck is designed to outvalue and outlast the opponent, using resources efficiently to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra land drops and get additional value from lands entering the battlefield. This is achieved by playing cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Explore to ramp and ensure land drops each turn. The deck also includes Primeval Titan as a win condition, allowing the player to search for powerful lands like Vesuva and Tolaria West that can further enhance the deck's strategy. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and The One Ring provides additional utility and threats for the deck.

The deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize. It uses a mix of direct damage spells, creatures with haste, and utility cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack to disrupt opponent's plans and close out the game swiftly.

This deck focuses on maximizing the counters on creatures by utilizing cards like Hardened Scales and The Ozolith. It also includes cards like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista to take advantage of the +1/+1 counters. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful and efficiently boosted creatures. The mana base is optimized to support this strategy, with lands like Inkmoth Nexus and Urza's Saga providing additional utility. Overall, the deck is centered around creating a fast and aggressive gameplay style with a focus on +1/+1 counters.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. It also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck is built to be fast and efficient, using cards like Fatal Push and Terminate to remove any blockers in the way. The key strategy is to maintain a fast pace of play and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on controlling the game using powerful control spells and card advantage provided by Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. The key concept revolves around casting powerful spells like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Time Warp to generate value and outlast opponents. The deck also utilizes land ramp with cards like Up the Beanstalk to accelerate its game plan and overwhelm opponents with efficient removal and card draw. The companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, provides additional value and synergy with the deck's creature base.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures through Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to combo off and control the board with powerful creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck also includes various aggro creatures like Strangleroot Geist and Young Wolf to pressure the opponent. Blood Artist provides additional reach and synergy with the creature-based strategy. The mana base is built to support the combo pieces and toolbox creatures, with support from cards like Nurturing Peatland and Verdant Catacombs.
